message: I remember one night when a sudden blackout hit while I was binge-watching my favorite show. I fumbled around, looking for a flashlight, and ended up shining my phone’s flashlight into a bowl of popcorn instead! 😅 After a good laugh, I realized I should really have my power bank charged and a lantern ready for next time. It’s all about those little prep moments that keep the fun going, even in the dark! What’s your go-to trick for power outages?
